entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
On the previous occasion when the matter was entertained this Court passed the following order:-
"Grievance is that notwithstanding the issuance of license under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the Police Chowki In-charge, Sidhua Bazar, is not letting the petitioner operate his meat shop.
In the facts of the present case, we call upon learned State Counsel to obtain instructions in the matter from respondent nos. 2 and 3.
Put up as fresh, once again, on 22nd January, 2025."

Rustam Ali vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 17 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129661939/

entities.text: Rustam Ali vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Standing Counsel has obtained instructions according to which no interference is being made in running of the petitioner's shop by the State authorities and has also stated that the grievance of the petitioner is imaginary.

Once that be so, we dispose of the writ petition with the direction upon the Superintendent of Police,
Kushi Nagar to ensure that the police authorities do not interfere in running of the petitioner's meat shop for which he has valid licence under the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, except in accordance with law.
